attempts.note: No counterexample: exhaustive enumeration of all connected simple graphs on 3,4,5 vertices verifies beta equals the bipolar-orientation count, and all 249 two-connected graphs have beta >= 1. No Mathlib/Mathlib2 chromatic-beta or st-numbering theorem found. Draft forge/data/staging/agents/queue-r7/queue-r7-w7/proof.lean compiles except for two intentional sketch holes: signed component sum equals bipolar-orientation count for connected G with adjacent source/sink, and existence of an st-numbering in a two-connected graph. Unsigned polynomial expansion, derivative/component-sum formula, conversion of st-numbering to orientation, and final cardinality proof are complete. Registering this as a two-hole sketch next.

theorem x2611_16458_cor2_5_s1h2_aux1 {V : Type*} (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    x2611_16458_balanced G ⊥ := by
  exact ⟨fun _ => false, fun _ _ _ => rfl, fun _ _ h => h.elim⟩

theorem x2611_16458_cor2_5_s1h2_aux2 {V : Type*} [Finite V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (E : Finset (Sym2 V))
    (hE : (↑E : Set (Sym2 V)) = G.edgeSet) :
    x2611_16458_zeroFree G ⊥ =
      ∑ F ∈ E.powerset,
        Polynomial.C ((-1 : ℤ) ^ F.card) *
          Polynomial.X ^ Nat.card (SimpleGraph.fromEdgeSet (↑F : Set (Sym2 V))).ConnectedComponent := by
  classical
  letI := Fintype.ofFinite V
  have he (i : Fintype G.edgeSet) : @SimpleGraph.edgeFinset V G i = E := by
    ext e
    simp only [SimpleGraph.mem_edgeFinset, ← hE, Finset.mem_coe]
  have hb (i : Fintype (⊥ : SimpleGraph V).edgeSet) :
      @SimpleGraph.edgeFinset V ⊥ i = ∅ := by
    ext e
    simp
  unfold x2611_16458_zeroFree
  simp only [hb, he]
  rw [Finset.disjSum_empty,
    Finset.map_eq_image, Finset.powerset_image]
  rw [Finset.sum_image]
  · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro F hF
    have hp : {e : Sym2 V | Sum.inl e ∈ F.image (Sum.inl : Sym2 V → Sym2 V ⊕ Sym2 V)} =
        (↑F : Set (Sym2 V)) := by ext e; simp
    have hn : {e : Sym2 V | Sum.inr e ∈ F.image (Sum.inl : Sym2 V → Sym2 V ⊕ Sym2 V)} =
        ∅ := by ext e; simp
    have hi : ((Function.Embedding.inl : Sym2 V ↪ Sym2 V ⊕ Sym2 V) :
        Sym2 V → Sym2 V ⊕ Sym2 V) = Sum.inl := rfl
    rw [hi]
    simp only [hp, hn, SimpleGraph.fromEdgeSet_empty,
      x2611_16458_cor2_5_s1h2_aux1, if_true, sup_bot_eq]
    rw [Finset.card_image_of_injective _ Sum.inl_injective]
  · exact (Finset.image_injective Sum.inl_injective).injOn

theorem x2611_16458_cor2_5_s1h2_aux3 {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι)
    (c : ι → ℤ) (d : ι → ℕ) :
    (∑ i ∈ s, Polynomial.C (c i) * Polynomial.X ^ d i).derivative.eval 1 =
      ∑ i ∈ s, c i * (d i : ℤ) := by
  simp [Polynomial.derivative_mul, Polynomial.derivative_X_pow, Polynomial.eval_finsetSum]

theorem x2611_16458_cor2_5_s1h2_aux4 {V : Type*} [Finite V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (E : Finset (Sym2 V))
    (hE : (↑E : Set (Sym2 V)) = G.edgeSet) :
    x2611_16458_beta G = (-1 : ℤ) ^ Nat.card V *
      ∑ F ∈ E.powerset, (-1 : ℤ) ^ F.card *
        (Nat.card (SimpleGraph.fromEdgeSet (↑F : Set (Sym2 V))).ConnectedComponent : ℤ) := by
  rw [x2611_16458_beta, x2611_16458_cor2_5_s1h2_aux2 G E hE]

theorem x2611_16458_cor2_5_s1h2_aux5 {V : Type*}
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (s t : V) (r : V → ℕ)
    (hr : Function.Injective r)
    (hmin : ∀ v, r s ≤ r v) (hmax : ∀ v, r v ≤ r t)
    (hprev : ∀ v, v ≠ s → ∃ w, G.Adj w v ∧ r w < r v)
    (hnext : ∀ v, v ≠ t → ∃ w, G.Adj v w ∧ r v < r w) :
    ∃ O : V → V → Bool,
      (∀ v w, (O v w = true ∨ O w v = true) ↔ G.Adj v w) ∧
      (∃ q : V → ℕ, ∀ v w, O v w = true → q v < q w) ∧
      (∀ v, (∀ w, O w v = false) ↔ v = s) ∧
      (∀ v, (∀ w, O v w = false) ↔ v = t) := by
  classical
  refine ⟨fun v w => decide (G.Adj v w ∧ r v < r w), ?_, ⟨r, ?_⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro v w
    simp only [decide_eq_true_eq]
    constructor
    · rintro (h | h)
      · exact h.1
      · exact h.1.symm
    · intro h
      have hne : r v ≠ r w := fun he => h.ne (hr he)
      obtain hlt | hlt := lt_or_gt_of_ne hne
      · exact Or.inl ⟨h, hlt⟩
      · exact Or.inr ⟨h.symm, hlt⟩
  · intro v w h
    exact (of_decide_eq_true h).2
  · intro v
    constructor
    · intro h
      by_contra hv
      obtain ⟨w, hw, hlt⟩ := hprev v hv
      have hh := h w
      simp [hw, hlt] at hh
    · rintro rfl w
      have hh := hmin w
      simp only [decide_eq_false_iff_not]
      rintro ⟨_, hlt⟩
      omega
  · intro v
    constructor
    · intro h
      by_contra hv
      obtain ⟨w, hw, hlt⟩ := hnext v hv
      have hh := h w
      simp [hw, hlt] at hh
    · rintro rfl w
      have hh := hmax w
      simp only [decide_eq_false_iff_not]
      rintro ⟨_, hlt⟩
      omega

-- The signed component sum is the number of acyclic orientations with prescribed
-- unique source s and unique sink t, when s and t are adjacent. The natural-valued
-- potential expresses acyclicity without introducing an additional definition.
-- The connectedness hypothesis is essential: an edge and an isolated vertex
-- would give signed sum -1. Exhaustively checked for connected graphs on <= 5 vertices.
theorem x2611_16458_cor2_5_s1h2_aux6 {V : Type*} [Finite V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (E : Finset (Sym2 V))
    (hE : (↑E : Set (Sym2 V)) = G.edgeSet) (s t : V)
    (hconn : G.Connected) (hst : G.Adj s t) :
    (-1 : ℤ) ^ Nat.card V *
      (∑ F ∈ E.powerset, (-1 : ℤ) ^ F.card *
        (Nat.card (SimpleGraph.fromEdgeSet (↑F : Set (Sym2 V))).ConnectedComponent : ℤ)) =
      (Nat.card {O : V → V → Bool //
        (∀ v w, (O v w = true ∨ O w v = true) ↔ G.Adj v w) ∧
        (∃ q : V → ℕ, ∀ v w, O v w = true → q v < q w) ∧
        (∀ v, (∀ w, O w v = false) ↔ v = s) ∧
        (∀ v, (∀ w, O v w = false) ↔ v = t)} : ℤ) := by
  sorry

-- The st-numbering theorem. One route starts with the edge st and extends a
-- maximal ordered vertex set by an ear. Two-connectivity ensures an outside
-- component has two distinct attachments, allowing its path to be inserted.
theorem x2611_16458_cor2_5_s1h2_aux7 {V : Type*} [Finite V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (s t : V)
    (hG : x2611_16458_twoConnected G) (hst : G.Adj s t) :
    ∃ r : V → ℕ, Function.Injective r ∧
      (∀ v, r s ≤ r v) ∧ (∀ v, r v ≤ r t) ∧
      (∀ v, v ≠ s → ∃ w, G.Adj w v ∧ r w < r v) ∧
      (∀ v, v ≠ t → ∃ w, G.Adj v w ∧ r v < r w) := by
  sorry

theorem x2611_16458_cor2_5_s1h2 :
    ∀ {V : Type*} [inst : Finite V] (G : SimpleGraph V),
      x2611_16458_twoConnected G → 1 ≤ x2611_16458_beta G := by
  classical
  intro V inst G hG
  letI := Fintype.ofFinite V
  haveI : Nontrivial V := Finite.one_lt_card_iff_nontrivial.mp (by have := hG.1; omega)
  obtain ⟨s⟩ := hG.2.1.nonempty
  obtain ⟨t, hst⟩ := hG.2.1.preconnected.exists_adj_of_nontrivial s
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hmin, hmax, hprev, hnext⟩ :=
    x2611_16458_cor2_5_s1h2_aux7 G s t hG hst
  obtain ⟨O, hO⟩ := x2611_16458_cor2_5_s1h2_aux5 G s t r hr hmin hmax hprev hnext
  let B := {O : V → V → Bool //
    (∀ v w, (O v w = true ∨ O w v = true) ↔ G.Adj v w) ∧
    (∃ q : V → ℕ, ∀ v w, O v w = true → q v < q w) ∧
    (∀ v, (∀ w, O w v = false) ↔ v = s) ∧
    (∀ v, (∀ w, O v w = false) ↔ v = t)}
  haveI : Nonempty B := ⟨⟨O, hO⟩⟩
  have hb : x2611_16458_beta G = (Nat.card B : ℤ) := by
    rw [x2611_16458_cor2_5_s1h2_aux4 G G.edgeFinset (by simp)]
    exact x2611_16458_cor2_5_s1h2_aux6 G G.edgeFinset (by simp) s t hG.2.1 hst
  rw [hb]
  exact_mod_cast Nat.card_pos (α := B)

children.statement: ∀ {V : Type*} [Finite V] (G : SimpleGraph V) (E : Finset (Sym2 V)), (↑E : Set (Sym2 V)) = G.edgeSet → ∀ (s t : V), G.Connected → G.Adj s t → (-1) ^ Nat.card V * ∑ F ∈ E.powerset, (-1) ^ F.card * (↑(Nat.card (SimpleGraph.fromEdgeSet (↑F : Set (Sym2 V))).ConnectedComponent) : ℤ) = (↑(Nat.card { O : V → V → Bool // (∀ (v w : V), O v w = true ∨ O w v = true ↔ G.Adj v w) ∧ (∃ (q : V → ℕ), ∀ (v w : V), O v w = true → q v < q w) ∧ (∀ (v : V), (∀ (w : V), O w v = false) ↔ v = s) ∧ ∀ (v : V), (∀ (w : V), O v w = false) ↔ v = t }) : ℤ)

∀ {V : Type*} [inst : Finite V] (G : SimpleGraph V) (s t : V), x2611_16458_twoConnected G → G.Adj s t → ∃ (r : V → ℕ), Function.Injective r ∧ (∀ (v : V), r s ≤ r v) ∧ (∀ (v : V), r v ≤ r t) ∧ (∀ (v : V), v ≠ s → ∃ (w : V), G.Adj w v ∧ r w < r v) ∧ ∀ (v : V), v ≠ t → ∃ (w : V), G.Adj v w ∧ r v < r w
